reference/index: Every component, hook, function and type React Scheduler exports, with a one-line description and a link.
reference/list-view: The list view on its own.
reference/scheduler: The scheduler: the list or timeline view, selected by view.
reference/timeline-view: The timeline view on its own.
reference/list-card: A list card (li) with its activator; renderItem replaces it entirely.
reference/timeline-card: A timeline card, absolutely positioned from the layout engine's output.
reference/diamond-icon: The pill marker: a 4 × 4 square rotated −45° about (0, 2.828) inside a 6 × 6 box, filled with the current text color.
reference/shift-header: The header row of one shift in the list view.
reference/shift-nav-button: The button that jumps to the previous or the next shift.
reference/pinned-chip: One chip in the pinned strip.
reference/pinned-strip: The strip of pinned items that stays in view while their shift is on screen.
reference/level-pill: The pill that shows an item’s level.
reference/reference-pill: The pill that shows an item’s reference number.
reference/tag-pill: The pill that shows one of an item’s tags.
reference/empty-state: What a view shows when there is nothing to place.
reference/error-state: What a view shows when loading failed, with the retry action when one is given.
reference/loading-state: What a view shows while items are being loaded.
reference/now-indicator: The list's now marker: the clock time in a pill, then a line.
reference/scroll-top-button: The button that returns the scroller to the top.
reference/more-chip: The chip that stands for the items a crowded group could not place.
reference/time-grid: The timeline’s hour grid, with the placed cards on it.
reference/tooltip: The tooltip part; position comes from useTooltip (null while closed).
reference/default-item-detail: The detail view an item opens into, as the library renders it.
reference/overflow-dialog: The dialog that lists the items behind a "+more" chip.
reference/overflow-table: The table inside the overflow dialog.
reference/use-compact: Compact mode from the element's content width; a boolean forces it. False on the server.
reference/use-controllable-state: Controlled when value is given, otherwise internal state starting at defaultValue.
reference/use-now: Epoch ms of now, or an internal clock ticking every interval ms, paused while the document is hidden.
reference/use-pin-on-pass: Pin-on-pass for custom markup: register sentinels, read the pinned keys.
reference/use-shift-model: Shift windows and segments for a date.
reference/use-shift-navigation: Programmatic shift navigation for custom markup.
reference/use-timeline-layout: The timeline layout of items, memoized on its inputs.
reference/carried-over-tag: Tag key the library adds to carried-over pinned items.
reference/classic-tags: The classic tag set: the two tags the classic preset renders.
reference/en-us: The English locale pack, and the default when no localization is given.
reference/default-overflow-columns: The columns the overflow table shows when none are given.
reference/pagination: The pager under the overflow table.
reference/bucket-items: Puts each item into the window with start ≤ item.start < end. Items outside every window are not shown; items with an invalid start are dropped; for duplicate ids the first occurrence wins.
reference/create-formatters: Builds the default formatters for a locale, which formatters can then override one by one.
reference/compute-timeline-layout: Places items into timeline columns and overflow groups: placement sequence, greedy columns, promotion from overflow, gap fill, geometry, overflow groups (bounded by overflowMergeWindow, measured from each group's anchor) and column counts.
reference/compare-by-placement: Placement order: start ascending, then level rank ascending (stronger first), then id.
reference/resolve-levels: Level definitions keyed by key, with rank (default: array index), variant and pinOnPass filled in.
reference/interpolate: Fills {{name}} placeholders. A plural template picks its form for values.count with Intl.PluralRules(locale), falling back to other. Numbers are formatted with Intl.NumberFormat. An unknown placeholder is left as written.
reference/page-list: Pages to show in the pager (0-based): every page when there are at most 7; otherwise the first two, the last two and the current page ±1, with 'ellipsis' in each gap.
reference/sort-overflow-items: Items sorted by the column's value; ties break by compare. The whole comparison, ties included, follows the direction. An unsortable or unknown column sorts by compare alone.
reference/get-shift-windows: The rendered shift windows around date, offsets -before … +after. The current window is [latest boundary ≤ date, next boundary); offsets walk boundaries across days.
reference/resolve-shift: The current shift window (offset 0) for date.
reference/resolve-end: The resolved end of an item: start + defaultDuration when end is missing or invalid; an end before the start counts as zero duration.
reference/to-ms: Epoch milliseconds of a date input; NaN when invalid. A string without an offset is local wall-clock time, including date-only strings (which Date alone would read as UTC).
reference/resolve-time-label: The time label of a card, first match: timeLabel as given; "{observed} {observedLabel}" when observedLabel is a non-empty string; "{since} {timestamp}" for a valid since, or the bare prefix for an invalid one; otherwise "{start} – {end}".
reference/create-scheduler: Creates a controller. This is the whole library without React: feed it options, read the view model, call its actions.
reference/create-navigator: Creates the navigator for one scroller.
reference/compensate-sticky-growth: Keeps visible content still when sticky (inside the scroller) changes height: the scroller moves by the same amount in the same frame, in every engine. The scroller sets overflow-anchor: none, so browser scroll anchoring never adds a second shift. While suspended() holds (a programmatic scroll that corrects its own target), a change is only noted.
reference/observe-compact: onChange(compact) with compact = width below breakpoint, now and on every change.
reference/observe-width: Calls onWidth with the element's content-box width now and whenever it changes. Compact mode and listOnlyBreakpoint use the root's width, not the viewport or the user agent.
reference/prefers-reduced-motion: The prefers-reduced-motion: reduce media query; false when media queries are unavailable.
reference/create-pin-engine: Creates the pin engine for one scroller.
reference/de-de: The German (Germany) locale pack, passed to localization.
reference/es-es: The Spanish (Spain) locale pack, passed to localization.
reference/fr-fr: The French (France) locale pack, passed to localization.
reference/hu-hu: The Hungarian (Hungary) locale pack, passed to localization.
reference/pt-pt: The Portuguese (Portugal) locale pack, passed to localization.
reference/ro-ro: The Romanian (Romania) locale pack, passed to localization.
reference/types-events: The types of the callbacks and of the middleware: what each one receives and what it may return.
reference/types-localization: The shape of a locale pack and of the formatters, and the helpers around them.
reference/types-model: The data the scheduler places: items, levels, tags, shifts and the layout they produce.
reference/types-options: The options of the controller and the props of the components, as types.
reference/types-slots: The parts, their owner state, and what every slot and render prop receives.
